Original sheet and mass normalization proved at all Dirichlet roots. Interior actual trace-direction contraction is exactly minus one half the normalized numerator. Full physical phase rotation remains open.

Actual independent normalized Hill data are invariant along complete original physical action flows. Actual finite and full finite-gap Abelian phase derivatives are proved at interior contributing divisors, with arbitrary finite support and closed holes. The full phase generator is positive (i/pi) times its value times the original certified physical frequency-circle period. Contour period evaluation, canonical orientation, terminal continuation and rotation on arbitrary support remain open.
